name: Events & What's On
seo: What is on in Cebu this month: Sinulog in January, neighbourhood fiestas all year, concerts and exhibitions in the malls and IT Park, sports fixtures and community meetups for expats. This section is being built out — if you run an event, add it here so people find it while it is still happening.

subSeo.Festivals: Sinulog in January and the barangay fiestas that fill the calendar — dates, routes and what to expect.
subSeo.Concerts: Gigs and concerts at the malls, arenas and IT Park venues.
subSeo.Exhibitions: Art shows, trade fairs and expos, mostly in the malls and convention centres.
subSeo.Sports Events: Fun runs, basketball, football fixtures and dive competitions.
subSeo.Community Events: Meetups, markets and expat gatherings — the informal calendar.
